subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook installation formally require `HOOK.md` to be a direct regular file no larger than 1 MiB?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and follows the hook install path's established fail-closed hardening direction, but it intentionally creates a new compatibility boundary not currently documented or tested as a public contract.

options.title: Adopt the strict boundary
options.body: Require direct regular `HOOK.md` files up to 1 MiB and merge the current canonical implementation.

options.title: Preserve metadata aliases
options.body: Use a bounded alias-preserving reader and add focused symlink compatibility coverage before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt the strict boundary
recommendation.body: Require direct regular `HOOK.md` files up to 1 MiB and merge the current canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced unified hook installation and has carried most of the security and containment work in this path.
